t: The Manrose SF100T 4" axial inline bathroom shower extractor fan kit with timer delivers effective ventilation for domestic bathrooms. Constructed from durable ABS thermoplastic, it ensures longevity and reliable performance. For installation in lofts or ceiling voids. This comprehensive kit includes 3 metres of flexible ducting and fixings, simplifying fitting. The fan operates with a low noise level of 41dBA at 3 metres, offering a quieter environment. An extraction rate of 85m³/hr efficiently removes moisture and odours. Double-insulated and rated IPX4, suitable for zone 1 applications.
b: Mount in Loft or Ceiling Void
